text_zh: 纵向标线：沿道路行车方向设置的标线，按形式可分为：———实线：表示正常情况下禁止跨越，紧急情况下确保安全时可跨越；———虚线：表示可跨越；———虚实线：表示虚线侧可跨越；实线侧正常情况下禁止跨越，紧急情况下确保安全时可跨越。
text_en: Longitudinal markings, set along the direction of travel, take these forms: a solid line means crossing is normally prohibited, and may be crossed in an emergency when it is safe; a broken line means it may be crossed; a broken-solid line may be crossed from the broken side, while the solid side is normally prohibited from crossing and may be crossed in an emergency when it is safe.

marking_type: yellow centre line / white lane line (colour)
text_zh: 白色纵向标线：分隔同向行驶的交通流；指示行车方向右侧边缘。黄色纵向标线：分隔对向行驶的交通流；指示行车方向左侧边缘、潮汐车道。
text_en: White longitudinal markings separate traffic flows in the same direction and mark the right-hand edge of the direction of travel. Yellow longitudinal markings separate traffic flows in opposite directions and mark the left-hand edge of the direction of travel and tidal lanes.

text_zh: 可跨越对向车行道分界线，也称为可跨越中心线，用以分隔对向行驶的交通流。……表示车辆在不影响安全的情况下，可以越线超车、转弯或掉头。
text_en: The crossable centre line separates traffic flows in opposite directions. It means vehicles may cross the line to overtake, turn or make a U-turn when this does not affect safety.

text_zh: 可跨越对向车行道分界线为黄色虚线，线段长度4m、间隔6m（也称为“4-6线”）。
text_en: The crossable centre line is a broken yellow line with 4 m segments and 6 m gaps (the '4-6 line').

text_zh: 可跨越同向车行道分界线，用以分隔同向行驶的交通流，设在同向行驶的车行道分界上。可跨越同向车行道分界线为白色虚线。
text_en: The crossable lane line separates traffic flows in the same direction and is placed between lanes of the same direction. It is a broken white line.

text_zh: 同向两车道及以上道路，车辆可以变换车道的路段，应施划可跨越同向车行道分界线。
text_en: On roads with two or more lanes in the same direction, the crossable lane line shall be used on sections where vehicles may change lanes.

text_zh: 禁止跨越对向车行道分界线（也可称为“禁止跨越道路中心线”）包括双黄实线、黄色虚实线、单黄实线三种形式，用以分隔对向行驶的交通流，并禁止双方向或一个方向车辆跨越。
text_en: The no-crossing centre line has three forms: double solid yellow, broken-solid yellow and single solid yellow. It separates opposing traffic flows and prohibits vehicles in both directions, or in one direction, from crossing.

text_zh: 双黄实线，禁止双方向车辆跨越。一般施划于单方向有两条及以上机动车道而未设置对向物理隔离设施的道路上，也可施划于视距受限制及其他需要禁止超车的双向两车道道路上。
text_en: A double solid yellow line prohibits vehicles in both directions from crossing. It is generally used on roads with two or more motor-vehicle lanes in one direction and no physical median, and may also be used on two-lane two-way roads with limited sight distance or where overtaking must be prohibited.

text_zh: 黄色虚实线，实线一侧禁止车辆跨越；虚线一侧车辆可跨越。
text_en: On a broken-solid yellow line, vehicles on the solid side may not cross; vehicles on the broken side may cross.

text_zh: 单黄实线，禁止双方向车辆跨越。一般施划于视距受限制及其他需要禁止超车的双向两车道道路上。
text_en: A single solid yellow line prohibits vehicles in both directions from crossing. It is generally used on two-lane two-way roads with limited sight distance or where overtaking must be prohibited.

text_zh: 禁止跨越同向车行道分界线，用以分隔同向行驶的车辆，并禁止实线一侧的车辆跨越。分为白色单实线、白色虚实线两种。
text_en: The no-crossing lane line separates vehicles travelling in the same direction and prohibits vehicles on the solid-line side from crossing. It has two forms: single solid white and broken-solid white.

text_zh: 白色虚实线，实线一侧禁止车辆跨越；虚线一侧车辆可跨越。越线行驶的车辆需避让正常行驶的车辆。
text_en: On a broken-solid white line, vehicles on the solid side may not cross; vehicles on the broken side may cross, and a vehicle crossing the line must give way to vehicles travelling normally.

marking_type: solid line (guide lane line at intersection)
text_zh: 导向车道线，用以表示车辆应按导向方向行驶的导向车道的位置。……设置于路口驶入段。导向车道线为白色实线。
text_en: The guide lane line marks guide lanes in which vehicles must follow the indicated direction; it is placed on the approach to an intersection and is a solid white line.

text_zh: 导向箭头用以指示车辆的行驶方向。（表1：指示直行；指示前方可直行或左转；指示前方左转；指示前方可直行或右转；指示前方右转；指示前方掉头；指示前方可直行或掉头；指示前方可左转或掉头；指示前方仅可左右转弯；指示前方应向左合流；指示前方应向右合流。）
text_en: Guide arrows indicate the direction of travel for vehicles. (Table 1 meanings: straight ahead; straight or left; left; straight or right; right; U-turn; straight or U-turn; left or U-turn; left or right only; merge left; merge right.)

marking_type: yellow centre line / white lane line (colour)
text_en: When used, yellow markings for longitudinal lines shall delineate: A. The separation of traffic traveling in opposite directions, B. The left-hand edge of the roadways of divided highways and one-way streets or ramps, or C. The separation of two-way left-turn lanes and reversible lanes from other lanes. When used, white markings for longitudinal lines shall delineate: A. The separation of traffic flows in the same direction, B. The right-hand edge of the roadway, or C. Both the right-hand edge and left-hand edge of a reversible roadway.

The general functions of longitudinal lines shall be as follows: A. A double line indicates maximum or special restrictions. B. A solid line discourages or prohibits crossing (depending on the specific application). C. A broken line indicates a permissive condition. D. A dotted lane line provides warning of a downstream change in lane function.
Broken lines should consist of 10-foot line segments and 30-foot gaps, or dimensions in a similar ratio of line segments to gaps as appropriate for traffic speeds and the need for delineation.
Center line pavement markings, when used, shall be the pavement markings used to delineate the separation of traffic lanes that have opposite directions of travel on a roadway and shall be yellow.

marking_type: yellow centre line (broken / broken-solid / double solid)
text_en: The center line markings on two-lane, two-way roadways shall be one of the following: A. Two-direction passing zone markings consisting of a normal width broken yellow line where crossing the center line markings for passing with care is permitted for traffic traveling in either direction; B. One-direction no-passing zone markings consisting of a double yellow line, one of which is a normal width broken yellow line and the other is a normal width solid yellow line, where crossing the center line markings for passing with care is permitted for the traffic traveling adjacent to the broken line, but is prohibited for traffic traveling adjacent to the solid line; or C. Two-direction no-passing zone markings consisting of two normal width solid yellow lines where crossing the center line markings for passing is prohibited for traffic traveling in either direction.
A single solid yellow line shall not be used as a center line marking on a two-way roadway.
When used, lane line pavement markings delineating the separation of traffic lanes that have the same direction of travel shall be white.

marking_type: dashed line / solid line (white lane line)
text_en: Where crossing the lane line markings with care is not discouraged or prohibited, the lane line markings shall consist of a normal width broken white line. Where crossing the lane line markings is discouraged, the lane line markings shall consist of a normal width solid white line.

marking_type: solid line (white lane line at intersection)
text_en: A solid white lane line marking should be used on approaches to: A. Intersections to separate a through lane from a mandatory turn lane. B. Intersections to separate contiguous mandatory turn lanes from each other.
Where crossing the lane line markings is prohibited, the lane line markings shall consist of a double solid white line.
Lane-use arrow markings are used to indicate the mandatory or permissible movements in certain lanes and in two-way left-turn lanes.
Where through lanes approaching an intersection become mandatory turn lanes, turn lane-use arrow markings shall be used and shall be accompanied by standard signs.
